name: Industrial techno (2010s London-school distorted machine techno)
lineage: 2010s techno subgenre emphasizing industrial-electronic textures, distorted-machine percussion, and unforgiving-mechanical aesthetic over melodic content. Perc Trax label (founded 2003 by Ali Wells, peak influence 2010s), Downwards (Regis label), Sandwell District collective, and Veronica Vasicka's Minimal Wave/Cititrax labels anchored the canonical sound. Cross-pollination with EBM, post-industrial, and dark-techno informed parallel Berlin Berghain underground.
